generation.prompt: Professional commercial advertising photography of Overnight Recovery Cream by the brand Lumen Botanicals. Campaign audience: Urban professionals 28–45 who buy dermatologist-tested, clean-formula skincare. Market: Germany (DACH). Campaign objective: Drive first-purchase conversion for the autumn skincare range in DACH. Art direction tone: Calm, clinical, warm. Understated luxury — never hype.. The product is the hero: centred, sharp, and framed with generous negative space on all sides so the image can be re-cropped to square, vertical and landscape formats without cutting the product. Clean studio lighting, soft natural shadows, calm minimal background, premium editorial colour grading. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no typography, no logos, no watermarks, and no packaging claims of any kind in the image.
